name: Czechia
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: Denis d'or
inventions.description: The Denis d'or was reportedly the first musical instrument in history that involved electricity.

inventions.name: Arc lamp
inventions.description: An arc lamp or arc light is a lamp that produces light by an electric arc.

inventions.name: Kaplan turbine
inventions.description: The Kaplan turbine is a propeller-type water turbine which has adjustable blades.

inventions.name: String bag
inventions.description: A string bag, net bag, or mesh bag is an open netted bag.

inventions.name: Robot
inventions.description: A robot is a machine, especially one programmable via a computer, capable of automatically carrying out a complex series of actions.

inventions.name: Cabin motorcycle
inventions.description: A cabin motorcycle is a fully or semi-enclosed motorcycle.

inventions.name: Water-jet loom
inventions.description: A water-jet loom is a type of shuttleless loom in which a high-velocity jet of water is used as the propulsion medium to carry the weft yarn across the warp shed during each pick.

inventions.name: Contact lens
inventions.description: Contact lenses, or simply contacts, are thin lenses placed directly on the surface of the eyes.

inventions.name: Remoska
inventions.description: A Remoska is a small portable electric oven with the cooking element housed in the lid of a pot.

inventions.name: Semtex
inventions.description: Semtex is a general-purpose plastic explosive containing RDX and PETN.

inventions.name: Tenofovir disoproxil
inventions.description: Tenofovir disoproxil, sold under the brand name Viread among others, is a medication used to treat chronic hepatitis B and to prevent and treat HIV/AIDS.
